de.name: Montagne Penchée

de.text: Ein tropischer Berggipfel inmitten des dichten Regenwaldes.

de.name: Matiti Paradise

hu.name: Montagne Penchée

ro.name: Montagne Penchée

en.name: Montagne Penchée

en.text: A hill located within the dense forest of Montsinéry, overlooking the remains of former penal camps.

en.name: Montagne des Trois Carbets
en.text: A tropical peak covered in dense rainforest.

en.name: Matiti Paradise
en.text: A water park with swimming pools and slides in the Matiti savanna.
